name: Rubber Tiles
author: Amal Kumar
preview_verified: Original 1K albedo visually inspected: graphite/black rubber, subtle surface wear and shallow joints; no recoloring required.
suggested_scope: Existing gym rubber floor and training surface only; retain independent green perimeter and original branding.
uv_guidance: One repeat per 2 m in both horizontal world axes. Map UV=(world_x/2,world_z/2). Keep physical tile scale when applying to individual mat meshes.
roughness: Use original ARM G; do not apply a glossy uniform coating.
displacement: Not needed for the phone build; use the original normal map for shallow relief.
notes: Source specification only; fetch_assets.py and C# are not modified by this selection.
